whenToUse: Multi-stage approvals with sequential or parallel stages: leave, expense, purchase, contract sign-off.
Showing who decided what and acting on the current stage (approve, reject, delegate).
avoidWhen: A simple linear progress indicator with no approvers — use Stepper.
Past events without pending decisions — use Activity timeline.
a11y: Stages are an ordered list; the current stage is marked with aria-current=step.
Reject requires a comment field with a visible label; decisions are announced.
